app_store.name: Emulator Console
app_store.subtitle: Local emulator service console
app_store.promotional_text: EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC and more services — running against your local emulator.
app_store.description:
Emulator Console turns your local LocalStack or MinStack instance into a management console experience.

Service list pages with filter, pagination, multi-selection and actions dropdown.
Create wizards for EC2 instances, S3 buckets, IAM users, Lambda functions, RDS databases, DynamoDB tables, VPCs and more.
Resource detail pages with tabs (Details, Tags, Monitoring, etc.) and action buttons.
Cross-service links, global search (Alt+S), region selector, notifications flashbar and terminal panel.
Dark mode by default.

Runs against your own LocalStack or MinStack instance. Nothing leaves your machine.

~150 services, familiar navigation structure.
app_store.whats_new: Initial release. Console emulator for LocalStack and MinStack backends.
